properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.inspector.upstream-liveness-probe-enabled
properties.description: Whether upstream liveness probing is enabled for proxied sessions. When enabled, idle sessions are probed with JSON-RPC ping requests and torn down on transport-level failure.

properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.inspector.timeouts.upstream-probe-interval
properties.description: Interval between upstream liveness probes for proxied sessions. The prober runs on a fixed delay and checks every active session.

properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.inspector.timeouts.upstream-probe-timeout
properties.description: How long a liveness probe answer is kept filtered from the browser stream. This is a filter window, not a death sentence: a healthy upstream may never answer probes (a spec-compliant SDK server parks non-initialize requests, ping included, until the session is initialised), so an unanswered probe never fails the session. Upstream death is detected only from transport-level errors of the probe POST itself (connection refused, DNS failure, connect timeout).

properties.name: spring.ai.mcp.inspector.timeouts.upstream-probe-idle-threshold
properties.description: How long a proxied session may go without relayed traffic before the first liveness probe is sent. Every relayed frame (browser request or upstream response) counts as activity; probe traffic does not reset the timer.
